hidden.xhem_plus: Anchored to one season's pool, and 2016 on without 2020.
hidden.xwoba: The same anchoring and the same coverage gap.
hidden.luck_gap: A difference of two season-pool numbers.
hidden.hem_plus_3yr: A frozen lab artifact with a window of its own. It shows on a one-year view.
hidden.war_pa_plus_adj: The park and pool adjustment behind WAR/PA+ is fitted on one season's pool, so the adjusted value cannot be re-weighted across seasons.

sem_plus.formula: IP-weighted mean of the ROUNDED per-season SEM+

war_ip_plus.formula: IP-weighted mean of the per-season WAR/IP+ on the starter pool

hidden.fip: Skill FIP is shrunk toward that season's starter pool and offset by that season's FIP constant. Two season parameters, so it does not travel.
hidden.xwoba_against: The same anchoring and the same coverage gap.
hidden.luck: A difference of two season-pool numbers.
hidden.sem_plus_3yr: A frozen lab artifact with a window of its own.
hidden.war_ip_plus_adj: The adjustment behind WAR/IP+ is fitted on one season's pool.

gmli.formula: relief-entry-weighted mean of the per-season gmLI
gmli.tag: established with 2+ seasons and 60+ relief entries, that module's own thresholds

rem_plus.formula: IP-weighted mean of the ROUNDED per-season REM+

riv_plus.formula: IP-weighted mean of the per-season RIV+
riv_plus.own_choice: There is no riv_plus_3yr in this repo. RIV+ is realised impact rather than a rate skill, so the weight is the innings that produced the impact, and the established thresholds are REM+'s because the pool is the same arms.

war_ip_plus.formula: IP-weighted mean of the per-season WAR/IP+ on the reliever pool

hidden.fip: Two season-pool parameters, as on the starter board.
hidden.swstr_pct: Swinging-strike rate reaches us as a rate with no pitch count behind it, so it cannot be repooled.
hidden.gmli_3yr: Its source ships no date at all, so it cannot be vintage-stamped beside columns that are. The window computes its own gmLI by that module's recipe instead.
hidden.xwoba_against: The same anchoring and the same coverage gap.
hidden.rem_plus_3yr: A frozen lab artifact with a window of its own.
hidden.war_ip_plus_adj: The adjustment behind WAR/IP+ is fitted on one season's pool.
hidden.luck: A difference of two season-pool numbers.

pli.formula: PA-weighted mean of the per-season pLI

recomposed.clutch: summed WPA / pooled pLI - summed WPA/LI

hidden.gs: The leverage board prints the season feed's games started beside the walk's own start count. The window sums `starts`, which is the denominator every other column on the row divides by; two start counts over a window would be two answers to one question.

dem_plus.formula: innings-weighted mean of the UNROUNDED per-season DEM+ (dem_plus_raw)
dem_plus.note: The one metric of the four whose shipped builder weights the unrounded value; the other three weight the rounded one, and each is followed rather than harmonised.

hidden.rate_1000_shrunk: The shrink constant is a season-pool parameter.
hidden.rel: The reliability weight inn / (inn + k) behind the shrunk rate; k is that season pool's constant.
hidden.dem_plus_pct: A percentile inside ONE season's pool. The window carries its own, beside its own value.
hidden.dem_plus_3yr: A frozen lab artifact with a window of its own.
hidden.tier: A cut on a season pool.

method: Every index here is the denominator-weighted mean of the per-season index, each season scored against its own pool, which is the recipe hem_plus_3yr, sem_plus_3yr, rem_plus_3yr, dem_plus_3yr and war_rate_plus_lab.window_values already use. 100 is therefore the average of each contributing season's pool and not of this window's, and ten points is not one standard deviation of this window's pool: pool_stats reports what both actually are, and no value ruler, tier or band colour is carried onto a window index.
war_basis_rule: A consumer must blank every eWAR column on this payload when war_provider or ewar_generated_at differ from the served basis, the way bullpen_export.join_war_rate_3yr blanks its columns rather than serving them stale.

overall.rule: PA >= 100 or IP >= 30 over the whole window

starters.rule: GS >= 10 or IP >= 50 over the whole window

bullpen.rule: TBF >= 100, or IP >= 20 with G >= 20, over the whole window

leverage.rule: PA >= 250 for a batter or starts >= 5 for a starter, over the whole window

defense.rule: defensive innings >= 400 over the whole window
